repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability and cost-tracking dashboard specifically designed for AI coding agents.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based local dashboard with integration for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenAI agents.
Purpose: Provides granular visibility into agentic workflows by tracking work steps, file modifications, test execution, and token consumption.
Use Cases: Financial auditing of AI development costs, debugging agent performance, and optimizing token usage for enterprise coding teams.

repos.name: simonlin1212/vibe-astock
repos.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, local-first dashboard for A-share market sentiment analysis and short-term trading review.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based engine that computes derived market metrics (sentiment, laddering, money flow) locally without relying on external AI for calculations.
Purpose: Delivers real-time, data-driven market insights and sentiment indicators for short-term stock trading.
Use Cases: Quantitative traders analyzing market breadth, identifying 'money-making' effects, and automating daily market reviews without API dependency.

repos.name: Flaminis/Dalaran
repos.description: Dalaran — Apache-2.0, robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series. ROS 2 native, reads existing .rrd recordings. A hard fork of Rerun.
repos.one_liner: A robotics-first, multimodal time-series visualization and data infrastructure tool.
bullets: Tech Stack: Rust-based, ROS 2 native architecture; a hard fork of Rerun optimized for high-throughput data.
Purpose: Provides a robust infrastructure for visualizing and managing complex, time-synchronized multimodal data streams.
Use Cases: Analyzing high-frequency sensor data, debugging robotics control loops, and visualizing time-series telemetry for industrial or financial systems.
